messages.subject_clean: ggvis svg export for over 5K points in the plot
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I am trying to download ggvis plot in svg format. When there are more than ~5000 dots in the plot, it gets error. When you decrease the number to less than 5000. It works. So, how can I give support to ggvis to download more than 5000 dots in a plot. (png is working)

I put an example code below;
https://gist.github.com/nephantes/9df687e63facb6c58a27f123844a70f5
and working version;
https://nephantes.shinyapps.io/ggvis/

To replicate it just change the "The # of genes:" to 1000 and download it in svg format (it is working fine). Increase it to 10000. You are going to get error (Failed - Network Error).

Let me know, how I can fix the problem.
Thanks,
Alper
